When Aisha asks in Session 6 if she is okay, Zoe responds: 'all good, just a run of long shifts. nothing a six-day weekend wouldn't fix.' A standard deflection. This is not a comment on a one-off instance — 'every week' signals she has catalogued a repeated pattern across multiple sessions, not just noticed it once. Jess also adds: 'you don't have to do the hospital bit if you don't want to' — naming the specific format of the deflection. That level of specificity (knowing it as 'the hospital bit') is only possible if she has observed it often enough to identify it as a recurring routine, not a coincidence.
